limitations: Synthetic secondary diagnostic; does not replace real-document DEV or GSM8K TRAIN endpoints.
No model-based hardness filter or replacement; actual raw headroom must be reported for every item.
Full notes contain the answer: answer-copy plumbing, not self-generated computation evidence.
Partial notes omit the root operation; corrupt notes introduce a deterministic off-by-one result.
Numeric-only mask is descriptive: only native tokens wholly inside the integer digit span; sign and boundary bytes are excluded.
Fixed grammar/seed sampling uncertainty is not natural-document or training-seed uncertainty.
All eight conditions and failures retained; no outcome-based replacement.
I6=.375 interpolates full logits; no likelihood-only mixture or fit.
Own is prefix-only greedy cap128 TOTAL actions; intact cyclic unrelated donors retain empty/error outcomes.
Numeric-only is descriptive, digit-only native-token support; no silent subset or error imputation.
All head/mix computations use16 positions; only actual native target slots enter saved vectors/metrics, never unused EOS filler.
Same frozen256 supports B0 and later terminal writers; scoring uses that SAME model as reader, no crossed-reader matrix.
No generated scalar answers, deployed arithmetic accuracy or generalization claim.
Family means are descriptive; no added post-hoc pass threshold.
All cost sums retain compilation and waiting; summed worker seconds are not elapsed wall time.
Global intact donors rotate across grammar families without grammar/content matching. Every own and donor note in this completed batch contains128tokens, so actual note lengths are equal itemwise.
Supplied-note sensitivity concerns true-answer likelihood, not verified arithmetic or greedy generated answers; own-note gains do not isolate calculation from expression restatement.

interpretation.reader_mechanism: Under I3, correct partial notes omit the root operation and final answer, improve full-span likelihood over raw, and beat a closely matched wrong intermediate result. This demonstrates reader use of supplied intermediate work on this synthetic cohort.
interpretation.generated_notes: Fixed I6 has positive aggregate own-minus-raw, own-minus-empty and own-minus-other intervals. Ordinary I3 own-minus-raw is negative and own-minus-other includes zero. All own notes hit the128-action cap. All donors therefore also contain128tokens; the control is length equal in this completed batch but crosses grammar families. The own-note contrasts do not isolate computed intermediate values from matching-expression or grammar restatement.
interpretation.heterogeneity: Descriptive family means show the mixed-reader own-minus-empty and own-minus-other benefit is concentrated in product_sum_difference; the other three family own-minus-empty means are negative. No family was selected or removed, and no family-level confirmatory gate was added.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic secondary diagnostic, not evidence of useful thoughts on real-document DEV or GSM8K. No generated-answer accuracy was measured. Complete supplied notes include the final answer and are copy controls.
interpretation.decision: Keep current real-document supervised runs and terminal evaluation unchanged. Preserve all256 items and controls; this result does not release RL.
